assets.name: space-panorama
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 360 degree equirectangular outer space sky texture for a WebGPU futuristic racing game, 2:1 panorama. Deep midnight indigo and black cosmic void with fine distant stars, a flowing violet and cyan nebula band, distant galaxies and restrained luminous dust. No planets, no ground, no race track, no horizon line, no words or logos. Panoramic left and right edges visually seamless, reduced detail at poles, subdued contrast so a luminous foreground rainbow raceway remains readable. High quality cinematic astronomy-inspired painted realism, wide 2:1 image.

assets.name: planet-azure
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent game sprite. One complete majestic blue turquoise gas giant with broad luminous icy rings tilted 25 degrees. Beautiful atmosphere rim, subtle swirling clouds, shaded lower right hemisphere and illuminated upper left. Entire planet and elliptical rings inside image with 12 percent padding, centered, no cropping. True transparent background alpha, no stars or backdrop, no text. Cinematic detailed 3D science fiction render suitable for a colorful outer space racing game.
